sub_site: adipose tissue (creeping fat, mesenteric VAT, subcutaneous AT) in Crohn's disease and controls

evidence.quote: Subjects were recruited at University Hospital Joan XXIII (Tarragona, Spain) and University Hospital Vall d´Hebrón (Barcelona, Spain)
16S-rRNA gene sequences were amplified from cDNA using the 16S Metagenomics Kit

notes: RNA (cDNA)-based 16S, Ion Torrent. Adipose from 5 inactive CD (MES-VAT+SAT), 8 active CD (CF-VAT, MES-VAT, SAT), 8 non-CD controls (MES-VAT+SAT): ~50 samples (n inferred). Sequencing positive only in CF-VAT and MES-VAT of CD; negative in SAT and in all control fat (could act as informal negative comparison). No reagent negative controls mentioned. Bifidobacterium/Streptococcus from own non-significant trends reported in Discussion.
